name: @butternetwork/wdk-protocol-swidge-butter
description: Butter Network Swidge provider for WDK.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:e2e:read-only: npm run build --silent && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.e2e --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/e2e/read-only.test.ts

scripts.test:e2e:cross-native: npm run build --silent && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.e2e --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/e2e/cross-native.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:status: npm run build --silent && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.e2e --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/e2e/status.test.ts
scripts.example:decode-swap-data: npm run build --silent && node --env-file-if-exists=examples/.env --import tsx examples/decode-swap-data.ts
